blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `validateDraftOrderStep`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This step validates that an order is a draft order. It throws an error otherwise.

:::note

You can retrieve a draft order's details using [Query](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/module-links/query),
or [useQueryGraphStep](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/references/medusa-workflows/steps/useQueryGraphStep).

:::

children.name: ValidateDraftOrderStepInput
children.description: The details of the draft order to validate.
